## Mismatch robustness: mixed model net ~ arm*mismatch + (1|year)

```
                        Coef. Std.Err.        z  P>|z|   [0.025   0.975]
Intercept               3.698    0.920    4.019  0.000    1.894    5.501
arm[T.physics_mpc]     -6.294    0.281  -22.419  0.000   -6.844   -5.744
m                      -3.617    1.765   -2.049  0.040   -7.077   -0.158
arm[T.physics_mpc]:m  -18.074    2.496   -7.241  0.000  -22.966  -13.181
Group Var               3.229    1.989                                  
```

The arm x mismatch interaction (slope difference) is -18.07, the two arms' net-value decay rates differ by a large margin, and with 6 mismatch levels the interaction IS significant (p = 4.46e-13): the learned guidance measurably insures the physics controller against its own model error, not merely as a directional effect.

## Humidity: degree-hours and banded gate (paired)

- RH degree-hours, RL-in-MPC vs physics NMPC: n=120, median 129 vs 807, Wilcoxon p = 1.38e-20.

- Banded gate, RL-in-MPC vs physics NMPC (McNemar exact): discordant pairs 16 (RL-in-MPC clean, NMPC violating) vs 0 the other way, p = 3.05e-05.

## Caveats
- The incumbent is a deterministic arm with only four independent seasons; its comparisons cannot reach significance (the smallest two-sided Wilcoxon p at n=4 is 0.125) and are reported as effect size only.
- Multiplicity across the pairwise net-value family is controlled by Holm-Bonferroni.
